name: Do I need a permit to install a gas line for a dryer?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to install a gas line for a dryer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in most areas, including Goodyear, Buckeye, and Avondale, a permit is required for the installation of a new gas line or modifications to an existing gas system. This is to ensure that the work complies with local building codes and safety standards. A qualified plumbing service will typically handle the permit application process on your behalf. Obtaining the necessary permits protects your home and ensures the installation is performed safely and legally.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a permit is generally required in most areas, including our service locations, for new gas line installations to ensure compliance with local building codes and safety standards.
